entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.

It is emanating from the material made available on record that the criminal prosecution under the penal provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was submitted against the accused-petitioner.

On 16.08.2001, the learned Trial Court after taking cognizance of the offence,
issued process against the petitioner, however since the service of the notice could not be affected on him, therefore, he was declared absconder on 21.07.2018 and therefore, a standing warrant of arrest had been issued against him.

entities.text: Ravindra Singh Son Of Daljeet Singh vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 January, 2022 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Nowhere from the record, it is reflecting that ever before any service of summon of bailable warrant had been affected upon the petitioner.
In this view of the matter, this Court is inclined to allow the petition.

Accordingly, the miscellaneous petition is allowed and the order dated 07.01.2021 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, No. 2, Kota in criminal regular case No. 6161/2014 is quashed and set aside.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, No. 2, Kota
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The accused-petitioner is directed to appear before the learned Trial Court on or before 25.02.2022.
Upon his appearance and moving a regular bail application, he shall be released on bail on the very same day provided he furnishes bail bonds to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court.
The stay application stands disposed of.
